effect_description_eng: [On Play] [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Belphemon] or [Gizmon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 card in your hand, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
